## Current Resource Clusters {#resource-clusters .section-title}

```{=html}
<div class="section-card-grid">
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Setup</span>
    <h3>Getting Started</h3>
    <p>Environment setup, reading equations, units, maps, and uncertainty create the calmest entry into the whole project.</p>
    <p><a href="../getting-started/">Open Getting Started</a></p>
  </article>
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">GIS</span>
    <h3>Spatial Analysis Toolkit</h3>
    <p>Spatial predicates, overlays, raster methods, visibility, and watersheds provide the practical GIS backbone used across the series.</p>
    <p><a href="../spatial-analysis/">Open Spatial Analysis</a></p>
  </article>
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Observation</span>
    <h3>Remote Sensing Methods</h3>
    <p>Observation geometry, sensor logic, and specialist sensing methods support both the core environmental chapters and the remote sensing library.</p>
    <p><a href="../advanced-remote-sensing/">Open Advanced Remote Sensing</a></p>
  </article>
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Inference</span>
    <h3>Machine Learning and Statistical Methods</h3>
    <p>Regression, dimensionality reduction, Bayesian thinking, and inference-heavy chapters belong here when you need later-stage quantitative support.</p>
    <p><a href="../machine-learning/">Open Machine Learning</a></p>
  </article>
  <article class="section-card">
    <span class="section-eyebrow">Practice</span>
    <h3>Laboratory Workflow</h3>
    <p>The laboratory turns methods into investigations, giving the project a place for advanced practice instead of only linear reading.</p>
    <p><a href="../advanced-investigations/">Open Advanced Investigations</a></p>
  </article>
</div>
```

## What This Section Should Become {#future-shape .section-title}

Over time, this section can grow into the place for:

- GIS resource pages
- modelling workflow primers
- data handling patterns
- software and setup guides
- quantitative method explainers
- reusable practical notes that should not be trapped inside one branch
